items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys shoot. Mixing a movement key with a fire arrow moves+shoots simultaneously. Diagonal moves stall on rocks whose hitboxes exceed sprites — reposition lanes instead of pushing. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse); it damages self; warping away does NOT outrun the fuse. Q/Space do nothing.

TECH X: the pill pedestal in the two-poop room granted Tech X ('Laser ring tears') in earlier runs and was re-offered on re-entry. In the latest run the pedestal was ABSENT on entry and firing produced only plain round tears (no lingering laser ring), so Tech X may already have been held/consumed or the room variant differs — uncertain. Do not rely on Tech X being available.

LASERS: when held, firing makes a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. The red squiggly ring is my own laser, NOT a lock marker or telegraph (uncertain). Lasers kill white-faced chasers safely at range only when aimed down the correct row/column.

KEYS: key counter stayed 00 in the latest run despite a key-shaped pickup possibly seen. Earlier runs showed 01 without a visible pickup. Whether 01 opens the rock-field keyhole door remains UNTESTED. Red-lidded brown barrels/containers are suspected key-locked (guess).

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decor (confirmed again — standing beside the lower one gave nothing). The dark chest room's two red-lidded UNspiked chests (upper-left ~(0.33,0.33), upper-right ~(0.67,0.33)) do NOT open on contact; approaching the upper-left one cost a heart (likely a chaser). Central spiked chest in the dark chest room is untouchable. Torch-room center gray chest is sealed by indestructible rocks (tested left/top/right) — ABANDON. Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin.

BOMBS: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing — never bomb at low health or adjacent to self. Rocks judged indestructible.

BOMB-WALKER ENEMY (TNT room): a bomb-holding walking enemy at mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction even when nearly column-aligned, and repeated shots often drifted slightly off-column. Unclear whether it is armored, has an offset hitbox, or tears simply miss; horizontal shots untested. Treat as dangerous; keep distance, do not melee it at 1 heart.

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOBS damage on contact, transform (winged/spread/large fast forms), and a large white-faced blob form exists. Green glowing thing near the TNT bottom hatch behaved like a fly/creature, not a collectible (not picked up, moved on its own) — treat as hazard (fairly confident). Rock field is a severe heart drainer; white-faced chasers pursue fast and cluster near hatches; also seen there: small spiky pellets (guess: turret bottom-right), spiked-wheel wall decor, blue-tear shooters, spiked-ring enemy, gray round enemy near top hatch, and a spiky black rock ring with a gray enemy inside at room center. Corner torches damage on touch. Dark chest room: small black creatures/chasers plus black blob/pit shapes at y~0.48; damage cascades there — entering with full hearts can drop to zero in seconds. Standing adjacent to containers while creatures roam is unsafe.

DEATH LESSON: entering enemy rooms without first thinning enemies from the doorway is fatal; at 1 heart any contact ends the run, so flee rather than fight.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times): warp needs near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame. Standing ON the frame blocks warp — back off ~0.15 and re-center, then hold; multiple attempts are normal. On failure back off/re-center rather than pressing harder.

MAP / ROUTES (all hatches confirmed working):
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49-0.50 <-> torch room; right doorway y~0.47 <-> dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch <-> tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48.
- Torch room: top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.16-0.18 <-> tutorial; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76-0.79 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above); safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height; right lane x~0.63 traversable down.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50, y~0.12 (approach from ~0.1 below); poop piles regenerate and drop nothing; center rock indestructible.
- TNT room (rock-field top exit): TNT barrels line the left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot point-blank); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies on the left-center; rock wall ring on the right with three dark teardrop objects and a small blue creature nearby; spiked black chest on the left wall; bottom hatch back to TNT room. Pink enemy behavior still largely UNTESTED.
- Dark chest room (right of tutorial): chaser den; two red-lidded unspiked chests (upper-left, upper-right), central red-lidded spiked chest, black blob/pit shapes, gold/olive specks; small dark creatures patrol upper-right.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource; survival gates everything. Preferred opener was Tech X first (tutorial bottom hatch -> torch room left lane -> gold hatch -> two-poop room -> back up), but Tech X was not present last run; verify before committing. Enter enemy rooms only after thinning enemies from the doorway.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the red-lidded unspiked chests (keys? shooting? — contact failed); whether key counter 01 unlocks the rock-field keyhole door; contents of the torch-room enclosed chest; nature of the dark teardrop objects in the pink room; whether the bomb-walker is armored or just hard to hit; green blob effect beyond heart loss; exact coin pickup tolerance; whether lasers open any chest through a rock ring (evidence: no); whether hearts can be regained anywhere; whether the dark chest room's black blobs are
